card.line: Machpelah is a cave and field near Mamre, in Hebron, that Abraham bought as a burial place. It became the resting place of his family.

moments.title: Abraham buys the cave
moments.text: Abraham asks to buy the cave of Machpelah and pays Ephron four hundred shekels of silver. The Hittites at the city gate see the field and cave deeded to him as a burial site.

moments.title: Sarah is buried
moments.text: After the purchase, Abraham buries his wife Sarah in the cave of the field at Machpelah near Mamre.

moments.title: Abraham is buried
moments.text: When Abraham dies, his sons Isaac and Ishmael bury him in the cave of Machpelah. He is laid there with his wife Sarah.

moments.title: Jacob asks to be buried here
moments.text: Before he dies, Jacob tells his sons to bury him in the cave at Machpelah. He says Abraham and Sarah, Isaac and Rebekah, and Leah are buried there.

moments.title: Jacob is buried
moments.text: Jacob's sons carry him from Egypt to Canaan and bury him in the cave at Machpelah, as he asked.
